subject.title: fix(skills): forward owner handle to bulk security-verdict fetch for ambiguous slugs

question: Should owner-qualified ambiguous skills be resolved by extending ClawHub’s bulk verdict API, or by an explicit OpenClaw fallback to the documented single-skill verification endpoint?
rationale: The current public bulk contract excludes `ownerHandle`; selecting a permanent cross-repository contract or fallback policy is an ownership and product-boundary decision, not a mechanical repair to this PR.

options.title: Extend the bulk API first
options.body: Add and document owner-qualified item identity in ClawHub, then update OpenClaw with redacted live endpoint proof.

options.title: Use a targeted verify fallback
options.body: Keep bulk requests on the documented `{ slug, version }` contract and resolve known owner-qualified ambiguous failures through the supported single-skill verify endpoint.

options.title: Pause this PR
options.body: Leave the current behavior unchanged until a registry/API owner confirms the durable contract.

recommendation.title: Extend the bulk API first
recommendation.body: Add and document owner-qualified item identity in ClawHub, then update OpenClaw with redacted live endpoint proof.

likelyOwner.reason: A ClawHub/API owner is best positioned to choose the supported cross-repository identity contract.
